name: dsic-noether
description: Roadmap #12: the symmetry layer of mechanism design, machine-verified at BOTH layers. v0.1.0: the Groves GAUGE GROUP (payments modulo h_i(b_-i)) with the deviation gain (the WELFARE GAP) as the gauge-invariant charge, integer-exact; implementability as EXACTNESS of the payment 1-form (Rochet cyclical monotonicity, no positive cycle); the discrete Noether theorem executed (Marsden-West midpoint variational integrator); the bridge: invariance => closedness => potential => stationarity, one algebra, two instantiations. v0.2.0 executes the excluded boundary — the CONTINUUM derivation Noether 1918 => Green-Laffont on the quadratic divisible-good family (x_j = theta_j - thetabar + 1/n), every link the ZERO POLYNOMIAL in exact rational arithmetic: [E]nvelope => [I]ntegration (Poincare/FTC, the gauge readoff) => [S]tationarity (efficiency) => [G]roves form p = h(theta_-i) - W_-i(x), both directions (converse = the closed-form charge -(n-1)(s-t)^2/(2n)); Noether I as gauge-orbit conservation of the charge (dG/deps = 0 coefficient-wise); Noether II as the gauge identity whose moduli reading IS Green-Laffont uniqueness (the solver reads the gauge off any DSIC payment and convicts off-orbit payments); four boundary controls K1-K4. v0.3.0 takes the two priced boundaries: T9 the NON-QUADRATIC face — the quartic family v = theta*a - a^4/4 closes the whole chain on the externality-free stage (charge -(s-t)^2(s^2+2st+3t^2)/4, a square times a positive-definite sum-of-squares quadratic) while a NO-POLYNOMIAL CERTIFICATE proves the coupled (sum a = 1) quartic stage cannot host the chain at all (degree arithmetic on the FOC factorization, with sharp controls: degree-3 soluble accepted, the quadratic linear FOC not convicted); T10 the KINK as piecewise-smooth Noether — the second-price kink as two polynomial patches with a COMMON gauge and the gluing [u] = t[x] - [p] priced exactly ([x]=1, [p]=w, [u]=t-w), first price passing the gluing yet convicted on the patch (residual -1), and the capacity wall in the continuity regime: x, p, charge continuous at the kink while the charge's FLUX jumps by exactly (t-w+1)/2 = x(t) (the surface term), the wall-to-wall weak-DSIC flat counted honestly; the gauge census extended by a two-parameter non-linear gauge read off coefficient-exact. Honest boundary: the general measurable-space Green-Laffont (GL79, and the general-type-space uniqueness PBS25) remains quoted; the kink locus is its territory. v0.4.0 hardens the code quality face with every mathematical claim frozen: every kernel throw carries a NAMED error code (mathematical CONVICTIONS distinguishable from input validation), the kink readoff's clean check single-sourced onto the kernel's monomial census, the rule dispatch an exhaustive typed switch, two dead kernel exports cleared
